methodSections.heading: Chicken Liver Mousse
steps: In a frying pan melt 60g of the butter with the garlic and some good pinches of salt and pepper.
Add chicken livers and cook for roughly 3 minutes then add the port and cream and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Transfer this mixture into a blender and while blending gradually add the remaining cold butter.
When the texture is perfectly smooth, pour it into 4 ramekins and then place them in the fridge for at least an hour.
Remove from the fridge, pour melted duck fat on the top of the mousse so it completely covers the surface and then refrigerate overnight.
Serve cold with warm toast and pickled vegetables.
